summary: 'Dancing on the clouds' is low fog from a dry-ice machine, about 12 to 18 in deep and lasting 5 to 6 minutes, for first dances, parent dances and grand entrances; it needs ventilation if it runs long. Cold spark machines are non-pyrotechnic fountains about 12 in square that throw sparks from about 3 to 13 ft, usually in pairs either side of the couple or a stage.
